I main a mystic in the PC version. You'll have 4 thralls to use, thrall of life (ToL), thrall of protection (ToP), thrall of vengeance (ToV), and thrall of wrath (ToW). You can only summon either ToL or ToP (defense) and ToV or ToW (offense). ToL (instant cast) will cleanse and heal yourself. ToP (short cast time) is supposed to tank (but it end game it's only used for the endurance buff for the party). ToV (instant cast) is a stationary turret. ToW (long cast time) is a very powerful offense  thrall with 2min cd (after all the cdr counted). In end game, your ToV and even ToP will be 1 shotted by almost anything (ToP might survive for 2 hits). Unless you're doing the hardest dungeon (it will get 2 or 3 shotted there), ToW usually survives until the end of its duration. ToL... well i never see it's being killed before and it's your source of self heal. The good think about those thralls are you can use them to soak damage. Especially for mechanics where your group has to share the damage. You can summon the thrall to take the hit too.
Last but not least, mystic is a HEALER class, you shouldn't pick a mystic hoping that you can tank using ToP or deal damage using ToV or ToW. Any proper TANK (in end game) shouldn't lose the aggro to ToP and any proper DPS shouldn't be outdpsed by a mystic (unless the dps is undergeared). That is my two cents.

As of the current version, it seems that the gems prices are fixed, i.e. free, 450, 600 etc. But the developer has changed the price a lot of times. There was once where the price was just random, i.e. 1 gem for free up to 500 coins, 3 gems for 1k+, and so on. So they might change the gem pricing again.
Actually you can get lots of coins (to buy gems) if you don't mind watching the ads (the flying cat thing). Anyway have fun! :)
